title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Lemon & Lime Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Lemon and Lime delivers a perfectly balanced citrus vape with the sharp zest of lemon and the refreshing tang of lime. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, designed to enhance your vaping experience with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Equipped with dual mesh coil technology, these pods provide consistently smooth vapour and bold, citrusy flavour. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design ensure seamless, mess-free refilling. Together, the pod and refill container offer up to 6000 puffs, making it an ideal choice for vapers who value convenience and bold flavour. Filled with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods deliver a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, suitable for both experienced and new adult vapers. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying your favourite Lemon and Lime flavour.
